study type: Retrospective cohort study using population-based registers
exposure: Elevated cohort selection in utero (indicated by a low count of live-born male twins)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of males born in Sweden between January 1990 and December 2001, who were followed for childhood cancer diagnoses up to age 15.
finding: Fewer childhood cancers were observed among monthly male birth cohorts with elevated selection in utero.
